title: [KBM] 2 finger zoom gesture causes false positive (verified on trackpad)

steps: Open Type in both key and shortcut remapping dialogs and perform the supplied two-finger pinch; record selected modifier and whether accepting/cancelling changes the remap.
In an isolated debug session inspect vkCode, flags, dwExtraInfo and down/up order at KeyHookProc for pinch versus a physical left Control press.
Compare accessibility/software-generated Control input and a normal Ctrl+key shortcut; do not assume all injected events are gestures.
Repeat leaving/reopening each dialog and switching focus to detect stale modifier/reset state.
prerequisites: Use a precision trackpad supporting pinch and an ordinary keyboard; use disposable mappings and do not install a global input filter.
reproduce.expected_result: Identify whether a reliable gesture discriminator exists. Any chosen capture policy must preserve intended physical/accessibility shortcuts and balanced key/reset state without treating an incidental pinch as intentional remap input.
reproduce.version_requirement: Current build; original2021 report is historical
